turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how have you been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm well, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My best friend is in hospital over her birthday. Can we still celebrate somehow?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, in a gentle way. Do you know what the ward allows for visitors?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? I'm studying for finals and I crash after lunch every day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Normal dip. Would you rather take a twenty minute power nap, or skip napping and take a walk outside instead?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, my roommate wants to talk. You'll know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you already eat the last yoghurt?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Guilty, I'll buy more.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, which box did you put the kettle in?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The one that says kitchen. Or maybe the one that says misc.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are like six that say misc.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I got a bit lazy with the labels near the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you help me look? I really need a tea.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Start with the small ones. I'll check the ones by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm finished with that, what's next?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Can you help me move the table?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done with my sister. Carry on, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, the afternoon dip during finals. What's your pick?
